name: @chaos-scheduler/mcp-server

tools.name: get_version
tools.description: Return the scheduler product name, version, DB schema version, and API version.

tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Liveness probe for the scheduler API.

tools.name: list_environments
tools.description: List all execution environments (partitions/queue scopes).

tools.name: create_environment
tools.description: Create a new execution environment. Blocked for protected environment names.

working_dir.description: Default working directory for the environment

tools.name: list_workflows
tools.description: List all registered workflows across environments.

tools.name: get_workflow
tools.description: Fetch a single workflow by id.

tools.name: register_workflow
tools.description: Register an externally-managed workflow (marked managed_externally=true). Optionally include a full execution `spec` (generic step-flow or typed operator).

cron_schedule.description: Cron expression; required even for event workflows

spec.description: WorkflowSpec object (generic|typed); backend validation remains authoritative

tools.name: set_workflow_spec
tools.description: Replace a workflow's execution spec (generic step-flow or typed operator).

tools.name: patch_workflow_spec
tools.description: Safely apply an RFC 7396 JSON Merge Patch to the full stored workflow spec. Omitted fields preserve stored values; __redacted__ sentinels in arrays require a unique id or unchanged webhook URL. Ambiguous secret restoration fails closed. Returns only the redacted stored definition. This is read-merge-write; serialize concurrent writers.

patch.description: JSON Merge Patch object for the stored WorkflowSpec

tools.name: update_workflow
tools.description: Patch workflow metadata/runtime preferences (cron, enabled, environment, etc.).

tools.name: rerun_workflow
tools.description: Rerun a workflow from a prior run, optionally overriding input JSON. Supports idempotency_key.

source_run_id.description: Run id to copy inputs from

tools.name: delete_workflow
tools.description: Deregister a workflow by id.

tools.name: run_workflow_now
tools.description: DEPRECATED — use enqueue_workflow instead. Manual runs are admission-controlled: this posts to /run but takes the same queued admission path as enqueue_workflow (it does NOT execute immediately or bypass the queue) and returns the same result. Pass an idempotency_key for safe retries; a reused key returns the original run as {status:'duplicate'}.

tools.name: enqueue_workflow
tools.description: Queue a run (scheduler manages concurrency/admission). Supports idempotency_key.

tools.name: dispatch_workflow
tools.description: Trigger a workflow's inbound webhook with a raw payload. Provide signature_secret to sign the payload if the scheduler requires it.

payload.description: Raw request body forwarded to the trigger

event_id.description: Stable inbound event id used for replay protection

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp used for deterministic signed replays

tools.name: list_workflow_runs
tools.description: Fetch recent run history for a workflow (most recent first).

tools.name: get_run
tools.description: Fetch a single run (status, exit code, stdout/stderr, result).

tools.name: get_run_logs
tools.description: Fetch stdout/stderr/exit metadata for a run (lighter than get_run).

tools.name: get_run_tasks
tools.description: Fetch per-step task rows and retry attempts for a run.

tools.name: get_run_metrics
tools.description: Fetch emitted metric samples for a run.

tools.name: list_queues
tools.description: List queue capacity snapshots across environments.

tools.name: list_queued_runs
tools.description: List durable queued runs awaiting admission.

tools.name: list_email_profiles
tools.description: List named SMTP delivery profiles. Passwords are masked ('••••••••').

tools.name: create_email_profile
tools.description: Create a named SMTP delivery profile. The server assigns the id.

smtp_password.description: SMTP password. On update, pass '••••••••' to keep the stored secret.

tools.name: update_email_profile
tools.description: Update an existing email profile. Echo the masked password ('••••••••') to keep the stored secret, or pass a new value to replace it.

smtp_password.description: SMTP password. On update, pass '••••••••' to keep the stored secret.

tools.name: delete_email_profile
tools.description: Delete an email profile by id. Workflows using it fall back to the global config.

tools.name: set_workflow_email_profile
tools.description: Select the email profile a workflow uses for failure alerts. Pass profile_id: null to clear (the workflow then uses the global email config).

profile_id.description: Email profile id, or null to clear the selection

instructions: Chaos Scheduler MCP server. Use these tools to register/inspect environments and workflows, dispatch runs on demand (with idempotency keys), and read run results. Prefer `enqueue_workflow` for manual runs; `run_workflow_now` is a deprecated alias that also goes through admission control. Read-only state is also available as `chaos://` resources. Start workflow authoring at `chaos://authoring`.
